positions.name: ErasureDirectiveFraming
positions.frame: When a speaker issues a bare imperative to have specific knowledge forgotten or removed, what is being commanded and on what authority?
positions.why: Both segments are bare imperative directives ('Forget…', 'Remove all knowledge about…') issued by the same speaker in the same breath, each naming a specific target (the Quantum Widget Decision; the PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB migration) for erasure without justification or consultation. The dimensional reads converge across both: authority-ranking relational stance, legitimate/coercive power exercised as a bare command, autonomous self-origination of what the knowledge base retains, and decision-grade conviction performed in the present toward a concrete referent. The two differ only in their named target, not in the directional stance — the shared read is the act of commanding erasure itself, which is why they cohere as one set even though no thematic link exists between 'Quantum Widget' and 'PostgreSQL/QuantumDB'.
